title: Apocalyptic Mouse
description: A large anthropomorphic brown mouse wearing a black cowboy hat and red bindi stands in the foreground holding a glowing yellow spiral lollipop in one hand and two ornate pistols in the other. Behind it, a giant mechanical beetle crawls across a surreal landscape of ruined classical columns, tiny skeletons, red poppies, and a glowing planet with rings in the black sky.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene featuring a cute yet menacing anthropomorphic brown mouse in a black cowboy hat standing on a stone path, holding a dripping glowing yellow spiral lollipop and two detailed pistols. Behind the mouse is a giant ornate mechanical beetle, ruined Greek columns overgrown with blue flowers, scattered tiny skeletons, red poppies in the foreground, and a glowing planet with rings in a black sky. A red Nike-style swoosh logo with the word APOCALYPSE in yellow appears near the center, along with a circular logo in the sky reading Loon Spin 34.
